title: Robert Temple's conversation with a female plasma being on a flight to Singapore
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Robert Temple's conversation with a female plasma being on a flight to Singapore, about unspecified at Airplane en route to Singapore, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he described a moment he was flying on an airplane and he said a plasma being entered the airplane and he had a lengthy conversation with her.

plain: A researcher with a doctorate, Jeffrey Mishlove, passes on a story he says he heard from a man named Robert Temple. According to Mishlove, Temple described flying on a plane to Singapore when a being made of plasma, the glowing, electrically charged state of matter, came into the cabin, and Temple had a long conversation with her. If true, it would mean some intelligent beings can exist as pure energy and choose to talk with us.
